(pa)༄༅/ /dkar bdud lcam dral gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+da puṇ+yā ya/bla ma mcho

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dkar bdud lcam dral gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+da puṇ+yā ya/ bla ma mchog dang dpal chen he ru ka /rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// de yi srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral gyi// rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bri// de la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gnas yid du 'ong bar yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris sku yod na bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma gang dgos dang*/ khyad par dkar mo nyi zla'i gtor ma zlum por mar byugs pa la nyi zla nor bu me ri sogs rgyan ci mdzes dang*/ mar la phug ron gyi 'og tu sgo nga gnyis spyod tshul gyi gzugs bcos pa/

gtor ma pad gdan steng du bzhag de'i g.yon du bdud rgyal gyi gtor ma gru gsum dmar nag la sha dang mar gyis rgyan ci mdzes/ dkar mo nyi zla'i gtor ma la nam mkha' rgyang bu dkar po/ ma 'byor na'ang chad pa'i skyon med/ dkar mo nyi zla'i sku bris pa'i tsaka li/ mda' gtsang ma la dar dkar btags pa'i steng du/ bdud rgyal gyi gtor ma la nam mkha' rgyang bu sngon po dang*/ ma 'byor na'ang bzod do/ bdud rgyal gyi tsaka li btsugs/ mda' gtsang ma dang sngon btags pa'i steng du btags/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod/ gzhan yang rol mo maṇ+ḍal nas dang bcas pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sngar nas byed bzhin pa yin na/ rdo rje phur yi dam gang byed kyi bdag bskyed bya/ pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gang rung nyams su blangs nas yi dam chos skyong sogs sngar nas 'bul bzhin pa yin na yi dam gang byed rnams la 'bul/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra lcam sring*/ dmag zor ma/ las gshin/ dkar bdud phur srung*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la phul/ kyi mchod gtor rnams so so'i gzhung bzhin phul/ khyad par dkar bdud kyi gtor ma sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog bzhin phul nas mnyes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa nyid 'dir dkyus su bsdebs pa ni/ dkar bdud kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum brjod par byas nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bh+yoḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas pas ri rab sgong rdor 'phen zhing*/ g.yon pas gling bzhi byo ldog tu mdzad pa nyi zla brgyas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang*/ bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs// thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma// dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can// srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang*// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/

dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad pa dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma kun+tīṃ bh+yo/ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ shan+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ wa shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bzlas pa byed na/ thog mar yig brgya dang yi dam gyi bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ lcam dral gnyis kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te gang bsgo ba mnyan par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la mā la dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ mthar phyi mchod nang mchod/ 'dod don gsol gdab bcas gong ltar dang*/ skong ba byed na gzhan du gsal ba ltar bya/ gang ltar yang bstod pa ni rdo dril bcas/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ni// dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol// ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams// skye 'gro gso mdzad khyod la bstod// hūm̐ dpal chen bka' yi pho nya ni// rlung gi shugs can bdud rta'i steng*// mdog nag ru mtshon thod phreng can// bdud rgyal mgon po khyod la bstod// hūm̐ bdud rta bra nag rus rgyan can// de steng gshin rje khros pa'i gzugs// ba dan mi snying khrom shing thogs// srog bdag nag po khyod la bstod// ces bstod do// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/

slob ma rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa gcig nas bdun gyi bar khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su chos byed pa'i gang zag ni dkon zhing*/ re re tsam byung ba la bar chad kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'byung bas/ de nyid zlog par byed pa la srung ma re bsten dgos te/ 'jig rten pa'i srung ma rnams ni bsten kyang dgos pa med pas chos pa rnams kyis snying rjes kun nas bslangs te gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs bsten cing bsgrub par bya ba ma yin/ des na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma khyad par can ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa re bsten dgos/ de'i nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa ches byin rlabs che ba'i srung ma 'di ni/ 'khon klu'i dbang po dang*/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen gnyis kyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas las dngos su gsan cing*/ de dag nas 'khon ston rim par brgyud de/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ de'i gcung 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sku mched kyi bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa'i sa skya pa'i pha chos lhad med pa rdo rje phur pa'i chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla dang*/ bdud rgyal thod phreng lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba byed pa la slob ma rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa gcig nas bdun gyi bar zung du ma gyur pa zhig la bya ba dgos pa yin te/

de la slob dpon gyi bya ba yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun du'ang srung ma'i tshogs rnams bskyed cing mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya ba'i bar dgos pa 'khor dang bcas pa da lan gyi gnas skabs su legs par grub zin/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu tha mi dad pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid nas/ 'dud kyi bar dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dang por me tog phog pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs sh+lo ka gnyis/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rjes gnang dngos la sku dang gsung gi rjes su gnang ba gnyis las/ dang po sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la rdo rje gzhon nu dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pas slob dpon gyis/

oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā sogs nas ko3haṃ gi bar brjod/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi tha mal gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma zla ba/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i snying gar nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag re yod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi yi dam chos skyong sogs la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dkar bdud lcam dral la phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ lcam dral gnyis las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang*/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ sku rnams tshur 'dus nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la sib sib thim pa'i rkyen gyis sku'i byin rlabs zhugs shing*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi rang dbang med par bsgrub pa'i mos pa mdzod ces gu gul gyis bdug dril bu dang rol mo'i sgra drag po mang du bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags tshan gnyis po'i mjug tu/ ā be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang brjod/ de dag ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba'o/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun gyi yi dam chos skyong sogs la phog de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dkar bdud lcam dral la phog pas/ lcam dral gnyis kyi gsung gi rang bzhin sngags kyi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la sib sib thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

sngags tshan gnyis rol mo bdug pa sogs byed/ de nas bzlas lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dkar mo nyi zla'i thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du bh+yoḥ bdud rgyal gyi thugs ka'i nyi zla'i steng du trag de gnyis kyi thugs kar sngags phreng gis bskor nas yod par mos la/ slob dpon mdun bskyed yi dam chos skyong sogs la gus 'dud byas pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dkar bdud lcam dral la phog pas/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ lcam dral gyi zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la sib sib thim par mos nas sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma nas/ mā la dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar gtor chog bzhin dang*/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la sngags gnyis lan gsum tsam brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams kyi mgo thog tu me tog bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul bzhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dkar bdud lcam dral gyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs nas phul/ slob dpon gyis phyag tu bzung la/

de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid dkar bdud lcam dral 'khor dang bcas par mos pa'i steng gi cha la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs nas rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod cig chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu dbang srung ba/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong*/ 'khon ston bal po/ 'khon shākya blo gros/ 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ khu lung pa kun dga' 'od ldan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kha skong ni/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sngags 'chang bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang*/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/

bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang khyad par rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'grogs nas bsrung ba dang*/ skyabs pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na 'di rnams kyi dam pa chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang bcol ba thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos shing don bsgrub par bsam/ 'di'i gtor ma slob ma'i mdun du 'dzin pa ma gtogs mgo thog tu mi 'jog slob ma'i lag par gtad cing sngags bzlas rol mo byed do// de nas srung ma 'di nyid mi 'bral zhing nye bar bya ba'i phyir/ rjes gnang thob phyin chad dus rgyun du mchod gtor ma chag par 'bul dgos zhes slob ma la bsgo'o// de rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba zab mo thob pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa'ang yon du 'bul zhing cha shas nas kyang longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas phur srung khyad par can dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshogs yod na phur pa'i tshogs bsdus pa ltar bya/ thun gtor sogs 'bul dgos yod na 'bul/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/

nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams la gshegs gsol/ go cha bsgo ba/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bdag bskyed skabs thob dang bstun nas bya'o// lam zab rdo rje phur pa 'di'i// chos zab gnad rnams srung mdzad pa'i// rab zab dkar bdud lcam dral gyi// mchog zab rjes gnang bya tshul ni// sa lo sku mched sku drin las// legs par thob pa'i sa skya pa// rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po mchog /kun dga' rin chen bdag gis sbyar// ces rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma thun mong ma yin pa dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang bya tshul 'di ni/ rang gi mchod g.yog pa blo gros gsal ba'i ka bcu pa kun dga' seng ges bskul ba'i ngor/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yig cha la brten zhing*/ de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams rje btsun sa lo chen po kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched kyi gsung rgyun phyag len gyis brgyan te/ sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis bgyis so// 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na dkar bdud lcam dral khyed kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ maṅga laṃ bha wa tu/ shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
